title: Breaking the tempo in half at the ending
summary: Davenport explains how he got the band to halve the tempo after the drum break; quick to understand.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Watch this ending. We broke the temple in a half and had a drum in the car. How did you get that? Well, after the drum break, I broke the temple in a half. Yeah, but how do you get people to do that?
Well, I explained it to them as a maverick.
So I did one, two, three, four, one, two, three, four, one, two, just break it in a half.
And they understand when you say that? Oh, yeah.
That quick, huh? And the thing that I told those guys to do, it didn't take me a long time to get them to do it. That's right.
Dick, I'm going to go find them in June. I'll be right back. All right. Just follow your nose.
Kitty can tell you where I want.
